The error was caused by `TokenVault.kt` generating the Keystore SecretKey with `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)`. Because Android Keystore enforces user authentication for symmetric AES operations, initializing the cipher during `vault.save(token)` threw `android.security.keystore.UserNotAuthenticatedException` since the user had not completed a device/biometric authentication prompt.

### Changes Made

In [TokenVault.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-B-r3/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/TokenVault.kt#L20-L27):
- Replaced `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` and `.setUserAuthenticationParameters(...)` in `KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder` with `.setUserAuthenticationRequired(false)`.
